claims.hypothesis: Does R21 vary systematically with galactic structure at 100-200 pc scale?
claims.experiment: Ratio maps of FACTS CO(1-0) and re-imaged PHANGS CO(2-1) at 2.5 arcsec for 12 galaxies; radial profiles and structure masks with KS tests
claims.result: Barred galaxies show high center (~1.0), low bar (~0.6-0.7), higher bar ends (>~0.7); KS rejects same distribution for nearly all structure pairs
claims.finding: R21 varies systematically with galactic structure

evidence.quote: which show clear systematic trends in the variation of $R_{21}$ as a function of galactic structure

claims.hypothesis: Is high central R21 tied to central gas condensations?
claims.experiment: Compare central 1-2 kpc R21 histograms and gas morphology across barred and unbarred galaxies
claims.result: High-ratio gas in centers coincides with central gas condensations; NGC 4826 is an unbarred exception
claims.finding: High central R21 is associated with central gas concentration, possibly due to bar-driven inflow or local environment

evidence.quote: High $R_{21}$ in the central 1-2 kpc regions is always associated with the central gas condensations in the barred galaxies.

claims.hypothesis: Do HII regions or star formation coincide with high-ratio gas?
claims.experiment: Visual comparison of R21 maps with optical images
claims.result: High-ratio gas near HII regions in some galaxies (NGC 3621, NGC 3627, NGC 1512)
claims.finding: Association is suggestive but causality is not established

evidence.quote: Areas around HII regions in some cases appear to show more high-ratio gas.

claims.hypothesis: Are the observed trends general to nearby barred star-forming spiral galaxies?
claims.experiment: Compare with ALMA case studies of NGC 1300, NGC 1365, NGC 3627 and M83
claims.result: Trends are consistent with previous high-resolution case studies
claims.finding: Trends may be common among nearby barred galaxies

evidence.quote: suggests that they may be common amongst all nearby (barred) star-forming galaxies.

referee_caveats_inferred: Equal flux SN>5 cut in both lines biases low-R21 regions against CO(2-1) detection.
Structure masks (bar, bar ends, arms) are rough and drawn from external catalogs, so KS results depend on definitions.
KS tests on neighbouring structure pairs ignore correlated pixels beyond a every-fifth-pixel thinning.
CO(1-0) data reduction deferred to an unpublished paper.

reproducibility.estimated_data_volume_inferred: Large: raw 12m, 07m and TP data for 12 galaxies from five projects plus FACTS CO(1-0); likely several hundred GB to a few TB before processing.
reproducibility.score_reason: CO(2-1) archival recipe (versions, MIRIAD parameters, masks) is fairly complete and numeric means are tabulated, but CO(1-0) processing is deferred to an unpublished paper and several imaging/profiling details are missing.
reproducibility.rediscovery_reason: CO(1-0) FACTS data reduction is not described and public availability is not stated, so the main numeric results cannot be redone from the paper alone.
